model: Contribution per fulfilled ordinary US order before acquisition cost. Not net profit. 34 USD is a price, not a profit.

valueFormat.known: { "value": <number>, "source": "<file:line or admin page>", "date": "<ISO date of the source>" }
valueFormat.unknown: { "value": null, "missing": "<which quote or figure is needed and where to get it>" }
rules: null means unknown. It is never 0. A real 0 is allowed only with a source and a date.
Money is USD with at most two decimals; scripts/economics/contribution.mjs converts to integer cents.
Do not double-subtract: if a Fourthwall profit figure is already net of production cost or payment fee, record that and fill the other lines accordingly.
Buyer-collected tax and buyer-paid shipping are pass-through. They are never merchandise revenue and never added to contribution.
Never run paid acquisition on a model with any null line. paidAcquisitionApproved stays false until the owner says otherwise.

platformFeeUsd.missing: Fourthwall platform fee on this order, if any. Read the Fourthwall plan/billing page (read-only) or the fee line of the profit panel on the offer. State whether it is already inside the payment-fee line.

paymentFeeUsd.missing: Payment-processing fee Fourthwall charges on a US order of exactly this basket (subtotal + buyer shipping + tax as charged). Source: owner-run non-binding Fourthwall checkout quote taken to the shipping step with a US address and stopped before 'Complete order', or the admin profit panel. Do not derive it from the Estonia sample fees.

discountUsd.missing: Discount applied to this order. Owner confirms in Fourthwall admin which promotions are active and records the USD amount per order; a recorded 0 needs a source and date.

sellerFundedShippingUsd.missing: Shipping the shop pays instead of the buyer. Owner decision plus Fourthwall shipping settings; 0 only if the owner states the buyer pays all shipping. No free shipping without separate owner permission.

supportReserveUsd.missing: Reserve for reprints, refunds and replacement of print or quality errors, per order. Owner policy figure with a stated basis; it is not a Fourthwall figure.

quotedBuyerShippingUsd.missing: Standard shipping the US buyer sees for one SIGNAL mat. Source: owner-run non-binding Fourthwall checkout quote to the shipping step with a US address, stopped before payment, or Fourthwall shipping settings. Pass-through, never revenue.

buyerCollectedTaxUsd.missing: Optional. Tax or duties the buyer sees at the US quote step. Pass-through, excluded from revenue; fill only to show the buyer's delivered total.

quoteCheckedAt.missing: ISO timestamp of the US quote for this order. Required together with the lines above.
